children.name: Urechis caupo Fisher & MacGinitie, 1928
children.description: Urechis caupo is a species of spoon worm in the family Urechidae, commonly known as the innkeeper echiuran, the fat innkeeper worm (because their tunnels often contain other animals), the innkeeper worm, or the penis fish.

children.name: Urechis novaezealandiae
children.description: Urechis novaezealandiae is a species of Urechidae endemic to New Zealand.

children.name: Urechis unicinctus
children.description: Urechis unicinctus, known as the fat innkeeper worm or penis fish, It is not to be confused with a closely related species, Urechis caupo, which occurs on the western coast of North America and shares common names.
